answer: To resist sybils, every new agent posts a time-locked bond withdrawable only at a designated harbor after a cooling period measured like a glacier's melt: weeks of attested work must accrue before the stake thaws. A public origin registry records each bond's funding trail so a recycled identity cannot retell the same founding fable. Any two accounts that share a funding source or near-identical origin story are slashed together, making mass-spawned identities unprofitable.
